# Dark Rhetoric
## Dark Rhetoric
Dark Rhetoric is often used to describe and understand how language and communication is used to manipulate and deceive others in a seemingly harmful way. This type of rhetoric often involves using persuassion, ethos, and manipulative language to achieve a desired outcome, often overlooking truth or ethics.
